description: Configure the function of the module here

content.name: suggestionChannel
content.description: Channel in which this module should operate

content.name: createSuggestionFromMessagesInChannel
content.humanName: Create suggestions from messages in channel
content.description: If enabled, the bot will create thread under each suggestion

content.name: reactions
content.description: Emojis with which the bot should react to a new suggestion

content.name: allowUserComment
content.description: If enabled, the bot will create thread under each suggestion

content.name: successfullySubmitted
content.description: This message gets send if a suggestion is submitted successfully.

content.name: notifyRole
content.description: If set, this role gets pinged when a new suggestion gets created

content.name: sendPNNotifications
content.description: If enabled the creator and all commentators get a notification when something changes on a suggestion

content.name: teamChange
content.default: Hi, a suggestion you are subscribed to got updated by a team member - read it here %url%
content.description: This message gets send to the creator and all commentators when a suggestion gets updated and sendPNNotifications is enabled

content.name: unansweredSuggestion

fields.name: Suggestion-Status
fields.value: No admin answered to this suggestion yet

content.description: This will be the messages that will get send when the user creates their suggestion and no admin has responded yet

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag of the user who created this suggestion

params.name: avatarURL
params.description: Avatar-URL of the user who created this suggestion

content.name: deniedSuggestion

fields.name: Suggestion-Status: DENIED
fields.value: Denied by %adminUser% with the following reason: "%adminMessage%"

content.description: The suggestion will be edited to this message, when an admin denies a suggestion

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag of the user who created this suggestion

params.name: avatarURL
params.description: Avatar-URL of the user who created this suggestion

params.name: adminUser
params.description: Mention of the administrator who denied this suggestion

params.name: adminMessage
params.description: Message by administrator who denied this suggestion

content.name: approvedSuggestion

fields.name: Suggestion-Status: APPROVED
fields.value: Approved by %adminUser% with the following reason: "%adminMessage%"

content.description: The suggestion will be edited to this message, when an admin approves a suggestion

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag of the user who created this suggestion

params.name: avatarURL
params.description: Avatar-URL of the user who created this suggestion

params.name: adminUser
params.description: Mention of the administrator who approved this suggestion

params.name: adminMessage
params.description: Message by administrator who approved this suggestion
